title: Find the percentage of posts authored by users who have never received a 'T
question: Find the percentage of posts authored by users who have never received a 'Teacher' badge, among all posts that have no comments and were last edited by someone other than their original owner.

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.XCL_002 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.XCL_026 = c.XCL_006
LEFT JOIN badges b ON p.XCL_033 = b.XCL_002 AND b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
WHERE p.XCL_040 IS NOT NULL
  AND p.XCL_040 != p.XCL_033
  AND c.XCL_006 IS NULL

eligibility.predicate: p.XCL_040 IS NOT NULL AND p.XCL_040 != p.XCL_033

measures.expression: CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.XCL_002 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
measures.multiplicity_argument: LEFT JOINs ensure one row per post in the base population for the denominator. For the numerator, the CASE WHEN b.XCL_002 IS NULL correctly identifies posts without Teacher badges. Although a user may have multiple Teacher badges (causing multiple joined rows), the condition b.XCL_002 IS NULL is false for all of them, contributing 0 to the sum. For posts without Teacher badges, there is exactly one NULL row, contributing 1. Thus, the aggregate correctly counts posts, not badge rows.
